title: Footnotes and endnotes odt 001
notes: real ODF notes: inline text:note (text:id ftn1..ftn3, text:note-class="footnote") with text:note-citation + text:note-body/text:p, splitting the body paragraph around the note. Citation markers are authored digits: LibreOffice may render citations differently (numbering/format), so the reference text covers the two body halves and the note bodies only, never the citation digit.
